headline: CeCe Winans Revisits Pared-Down Worship Music on ‘The Hymns’
context: Best known for contemporary stylings of praise music that topped charts across genres, this singer’s new album of pared-down sacred music, “The Hymns,” put her back atop the gospel charts.

sources.name: The New York Times
